title: Mushroom and Ovoli Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful appetizer featuring marinated mushrooms and ovoli, grilled to perfection. This recipe showcases the vibrant and smoky flavors of the ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Chinese five-spice, vegetable oil, soy sauce, and honey. Add sliced mushrooms and ovoli, tossing to coat.
Thread mushroom and ovoli mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
